-- Rotate an 8-bit value left (rotl8) or right (rotr8) by k bits, k in 0..7.

rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0
  pre k <= 7
  post rotr8(out, k) == x
  ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
  ex rotl8(1, 7) == 128
  ex rotl8(200, 0) == 200
  decreases k
  var y = x
  for i in range(0, k)
    if y >= 128
      y = (y - 128) * 2 + 1
    else
      y = y * 2
  y

rotr8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0
  pre k <= 7
  post rotl8(out, k) == x
  ex rotr8(3, 1) == 129
  decreases k
  var y = x
  for i in range(0, k)
    if y % 2 == 1
      y = (y - 1) // 2 + 128
    else
      y = y // 2
  y
